exposure: type of operative vaginal delivery instrument used
station of the presenting part at which the OVD was performed
outcome: maternal complications related to operative vaginal delivery
cohort: Medical records of 326 mothers who underwent operative vaginal delivery between December 2019 and November 2021 at NEMCS hospitals, Southwest Ethiopia.
finding: Maternal complications were prevalent in 19% of cases, and were significantly associated with the type of OVD instrument, station of presenting part, neonatal birth weight, and duration of the second stage.
mod_finding: The type of operative vaginal delivery instrument used was significantly associated with maternal complications.
birth_weight: Birth weight was measured for included neonates and identified as a significant factor.
